# `house_disclosure_pages`

**House disclosure source pages**

One visited original PDF page, preserving native text and explicit image/layout failures.

**Coverage.** Sampled. One declared retained index snapshot and explicitly selected periodic transaction report originals. Other categories are discovery only; image-form extraction and source-wide completeness remain unqualified. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

**Data quality.** Native blanks, ranges, repeated index entries and original/amended observations remain separate. Refused reading is not a valid empty report. Page regions retain unqualified checkboxes; annual sections and scanned transactions are outside this pilot.

- **Parquet file:** `house_disclosure_pages.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |

| `page_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity of a page within one exact selected report version. |
| `report_id` | `VARCHAR` | Identity binding a selected index observation to one exact original PDF version. |
| `doc_id` | `VARCHAR` | Literal House filing DocID; distinct from a native transaction ID. |
| `source_uri` | `VARCHAR` | Official URL of the selected original PDF. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the exact original PDF, separate from index and derived output hashes. |
